title: Build an AI Code Reviewer with OpenRouter
excerpt: Code reviewers that only read a Git diff have to guess whether a change breaks anything, and their fixes come back as prose you apply by hand. This guide builds a Python reviewer on the OpenRouter Responses API that uploads your changed files into a Linux sandbox, runs checks to confirm each bug, and returns validated patches. A review takes one to four minutes and costs $0.015 to $0.045.
